title: Provide mechanism to make toolCallId unique across multiple call of streamText.
body:
### Description

If we have a task, which will execute a tool call in client side for mutlple times. 
Here is the example case:
1. LLM triggers a tool call, ai-sdk send it to the client.
2. client execute the tool, and send the result to LLM.
3. LLM checks the result and ask for executing the same tool for a second time.

If we want to combine the above interaction into parts of a single UIMessage, sometimes there will be duplicated toolCallId across the steps. Because some LLM(for example: google gemini flash) will produce sample toolCallId across different streamText call.

One solution is to override onChunk, and change the toolCallId to a customized one. But, this only changes toolCallId in UIMessage, while the toolCallId passed to ToolExecuteFunction will not change in this case.

Is there a general solution for this case?

### AI SDK Version

ai: 5.0.0

linked_prs.title: docs(provider): document all tool call properties
linked_prs.body:
## Background

It was not specified that tool call ids need to be unique.
